# Bread & Bite Cloud Kitchen - Navi Mumbai

> Homestyle Mughlai and North Indian Cloud Kitchen located in Taloja Phase 1, Navi Mumbai. Known for hearty 500-gram chicken gravies, freshly baked tandoori rotis, soft ladi pavs, burgers, and crispy snacks at honest everyday prices.

## Core Identity & Location
- **Brand Name:** Bread & Bite
- **Business Type:** Cloud Kitchen / Delivery Restaurant
- **Location:** Shop 12, Ground Floor, Sector 11, Taloja Phase 1, Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra 410208, India
- **Coordinates:** Latitude 19.0647° N, Longitude 73.1209° E
- **Primary Website:** https://breadandbite.in/
- **Ordering Channels:** Direct Website (https://breadandbite.in/menu/), Party & Bulk Orders (https://breadandbite.in/party-orders/), WhatsApp Hotline (+91 93256 29256), Swiggy (https://www.swiggy.com/direct/brand/675246?source=swiggy-direct&subSource=generic), and Zomato (https://link.zomato.com/xqzv/rshare?id=10960061830563279)
- **Kitchen Hours:** 2 Daily Operational Slots — Lunch: 11:15 AM – 3:30 PM & Dinner: 7:00 PM – 9:45 PM IST (Daily, 7 days a week)
- **Average Delivery Time:** 10–35 minutes across Navi Mumbai
- **Free Delivery:** Starting ₹299 (Taloja), ₹399 (Kharghar/Kamothe/Kalamboli), and ₹699 (Panvel/CBD Belapur)

## Signature Menu & Pricing (Direct Dish Pages)
All chicken dishes are cooked with 100% Halal fresh chicken sourced daily. No frozen chicken or preserved gravies are used.

### Chicken Gravies (Generous 500g Servings - Serves 2 people)
- **Chicken Keema Boneless (500g) - ₹199:** https://breadandbite.in/menu/chicken-keema-boneless-500g/ — Minced boneless chicken slow-cooked with roasted spices, onions, tomatoes, and fresh coriander.
- **Chicken Korma (500g) - ₹199:** https://breadandbite.in/menu/chicken-korma-500g/ — Tender chicken pieces cooked in rich, mildly spiced onion-cashew korma gravy.
- **Random Chicken Gravy / Chef's Special (500g) - ₹199:** https://breadandbite.in/menu/random-chicken-gravy-500g/ — Daily special homestyle chicken curry cooked with traditional Mumbai spices.

### Fresh Breads & Pav
- **Tandoori Roti - ₹30:** https://breadandbite.in/menu/tandoori-roti/ — Hot, freshly baked whole wheat roti made on order.
- **Ladi Pav (4 pieces) - ₹30:** https://breadandbite.in/menu/ladi-pav-4-pieces/ — Soft, fresh bakery ladi pavs. Classic pair with keema.

### Fast Food, Snacks & Burgers
- **Crispy Chicken Burger - ₹149:** https://breadandbite.in/menu/crispy-chicken-burger/ — Spiced crispy chicken patty, lettuce, sliced onions, creamy mayonnaise in toasted bun.
- **French Fries (200g) - ₹99:** https://breadandbite.in/menu/french-fries-200g/ — Freshly fried salted golden potato fries served with ketchup.
- **Plain Masala Maggi - ₹99:** https://breadandbite.in/menu/plain-maggi/ — Classic hot masala noodles cooked fresh.

### Value Meal Combos
- **Keema Pav Meal - ₹219 (Save ₹10):** https://breadandbite.in/menu/keema-pav-meal/ — 500g Chicken Keema Boneless + 4 Soft Pavs.
- **Chicken Korma & Roti Meal - ₹249 (Save ₹10):** https://breadandbite.in/menu/chicken-korma-roti-meal/ — 500g Chicken Korma + 2 Hot Tandoori Rotis.
- **Burger & Fries Combo - ₹229 (Save ₹19):** https://breadandbite.in/menu/burger-fries-combo/ — 1 Crispy Chicken Burger + 1 French Fries (200g).

### Desserts & Sweets
- **Warm Choco Lava Cake - ₹89:** https://breadandbite.in/menu/choco-lava-cake/ — Rich chocolate cake with a molten, gooey chocolate fudge centre.
